title: #031. Distinct Channel Assignment
subtitle: Model unique radio channel selection with distinct(x) and adjacent-channel separation on Pumpkin CP.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { channels, totalCost }.
judge.m3: Channel {p0} is assigned to more than one transmitter; all transmitters must use distinct channels.
judge.m4: Adjacent-conflict pair ({p0}, {p1}) received channels {p2} and {p3}, violating |c_u - c_v| >= 2.
judge.m5: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed weighted channel cost ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid distinct channel assignment, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
